name: Almanac of American Politics
provider: The Almanac of American Politics, a division of Columbia Books & Information Services (CBIS), Arlington, VA; chief author of the 2026 edition Louis Jacobson; earlier editions published with National Journal (founding author Michael Barone)
description: Biennial reference book (latest 2026 edition) with narrative profiles of every member of Congress and governor and of each state, territory and House district, together with election and presidential-vote results, key House and Senate votes, interest-group ratings, campaign finance and Census-derived district demographics.
institutional_access_note: Sold as print and e-book (library sets of recent editions available); the publisher site describes no site-licensed online database. Some libraries formerly accessed it online via National Journal (Berkeley lists it inside National Journal Policy Central). Listed by Princeton, UC Berkeley, Chicago (D'Angelo Law), Denver, Bowdoin and University of Washington guides.
